details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:35-54 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS_BLOCK` strips only one trailing newline, which can leave extra whitespace in rendered multi-line hints.
  WHY: `${SERENA_TOOL_HINTS_BLOCK%$'\n'}` removes at most a single newline, so heredoc-style inputs with additional trailing newlines can still render with a blank line.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:73-78 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The unresolved-placeholder guard only matches an exact standalone `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}` line, so embedded or differently spaced placeholders can slip through.
  WHY: The regex is anchored to a whole line, so it does not detect non-standalone occurrences that would still render literal placeholder text.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:325-331 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose render call no longer passes `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS`, so the diagnose prompt loses Serena navigation guidance even when Serena is available.
  WHY: `prompts/mode-implement-diagnose.txt` still contains `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}`, and rendering it with the default empty value leaves that section blank.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:98-115 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The simplified TOML patch can rewrite `model_reasoning_effort` in the wrong scope or append it under the last table instead of top-level.
  WHY: The grep/sed approach matches any scoped key and appends at EOF when missing, which can leave the intended diagnose override ineffective.
- tests/test_implement_semble_contract.py:165-171 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The contract test no longer verifies that `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS` is passed into the diagnose render call.
  WHY: The new assertion only checks for `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh "${DIAGNOSE_MODE_PROMPT_TEMPLATE}"`, so a Serena-guidance regression would now pass silently.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:146-161 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_finalize_serena_summary` can fill `serena_observed_prompt_tokens` from aggregate `or_prompt_tokens`, fabricating a same-run comparison from workflow-wide totals.
  WHY: When no same-run observation exists, using aggregate prompt tokens mixes runs and produces bogus Serena savings ratios.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:177-316 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Serena query and fallback counts are bucketed by the raw `target=` string, which splits the same workflow across different keys.
  WHY: Variants like `review_autofix` and `review-autofix-editor` are treated separately, distorting fallback ratios and hiding the true rollout state.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:250-255 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Fallback-only targets get `fallback_ratio=None` because the ratio is computed against `query_calls` only.
  WHY: When a target has fallbacks but no query calls, the report shows `-` instead of 100%, which understates total failure cases.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:38-54 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS_BLOCK` only strips one trailing newline, and the guard only catches exact standalone `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}` lines.
  WHY: Multi-line Serena hints can retain awkward trailing whitespace, and embedded or variably spaced placeholders can slip through undetected.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:325-331 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The diagnose render call no longer passes `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS`, so the prompt receives an empty Serena-hints block even when Serena is available.
  WHY: The template still contains `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}`, but the removed construction means the guidance is never populated.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:98-115 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The TOML config patch can place `model_reasoning_effort` in the wrong scope.
  WHY: The grep/sed logic can rewrite a table-scoped key or append the key under the last table instead of top-level, so the override may not take effect.
- tests/test_implement_semble_contract.py:168 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test now asserts only `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh "${DIAGNOSE_MODE_PROMPT_TEMPLATE}"`, which no longer checks that Serena hints are passed.
  WHY: This allows a diagnose regression that drops Serena guidance to pass unnoticed.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:177-316 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Serena query/fallback parsing keys targets by the raw `target=` string without normalization.
  WHY: Query rollups and fallback logs can use different target spellings, splitting the same workflow across buckets and distorting fallback ratios.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:155-161 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_finalize_serena_summary` can use aggregate `or_prompt_tokens` as `serena_observed_prompt_tokens`.
  WHY: That fabricates a same-run comparison from workflow-wide totals and produces bogus Serena savings ratios.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:328 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The diagnose render call is `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh "${DIAGNOSE_MODE_PROMPT_TEMPLATE}"` with no `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS` prefix.
  WHY: The prompt template still contains `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}`, so diagnose runs now render an empty Serena-hints section even when Serena is available.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:149-154 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_finalize_serena_summary` can assign aggregate `or_prompt_tokens` to `serena_observed_prompt_tokens` when no same-run observation exists.
  WHY: This turns workflow-wide totals into a fake same-run comparison and can misreport Serena savings.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:285-316 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Serena query and fallback counts are keyed by raw `target=` values.
  WHY: Different spellings for the same workflow split the metrics into separate buckets, so fallback ratios become misleading.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:105-106 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The simplified config patch can rewrite or append `model_reasoning_effort` in the wrong TOML scope.
  WHY: A scoped key can be rewritten inside an unrelated table, and EOF appends become last-table scoped instead of top-level.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:35-54 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS_BLOCK="${SERENA_TOOL_HINTS:-}"` is trimmed with a single `${...%$'\n'}` removal.
  WHY: Multi-line heredoc hints that end with more than one newline can keep extra whitespace in the rendered prompt.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:73-78 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unresolved-placeholder guard only matches an exact standalone `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}` line.
  WHY: Prompt templates with embedded or variably spaced placeholders can render literal text without being detected.
- tests/test_implement_semble_contract.py:165-171 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The assertion checks only for `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh "${DIAGNOSE_MODE_PROMPT_TEMPLATE}"` and no longer enforces `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS`.
  WHY: The test can pass even if diagnose stops passing Serena guidance into the renderer.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:325-331 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The render call is plain `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh ...` with no `SERENA_TOOL_HINTS="${DIAGNOSE_SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}"`.
  WHY: The diagnose template’s Serena placeholder renders empty, so guidance disappears despite `SERENA_AVAILABLE=true`.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:98-115 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `sed -i` can match and rewrite the first `model_reasoning_effort` anywhere, and EOF appends can land under the last table.
  WHY: That leaves the top-level diagnose reasoning override unchanged or scopes it to the wrong TOML table.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:146-161 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_finalize_serena_summary` can set `observed_prompt_tokens` from aggregate `or_prompt_tokens`.
  WHY: It mixes cross-run totals into what should be a same-run observation and yields bogus ratios.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:177-316 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_extract_log_field("target")` is used without normalizing target names.
  WHY: Targets like `review_autofix` and `review-autofix-editor` get split apart, hiding real fallback rates.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:250-255 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_ratio(fallbacks, query_calls)` makes fallback-only targets report `None`.
  WHY: A 100% fallback target shows `-` instead of 100%, which understates rollout failures.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:325-331 | severity=high | confidence=5

  WHY: The template still expects `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}`, but the removed construction means no navigation guidance reaches the model.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:98-115 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The simplified config patch can put `model_reasoning_effort` in the wrong TOML scope.
  WHY: It can rewrite a scoped key or append the key after tables, so the diagnose override may not apply at the top level.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:151-161 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_finalize_serena_summary` can assign `or_prompt_tokens` to `serena_observed_prompt_tokens` when only aggregate totals are available.
  WHY: That fabricates a same-run prompt-token comparison from mixed runs and misreports Serena savings.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:285-316 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Serena targets are keyed by the raw `target=` string, so query and fallback emissions for the same workflow can split apart.
  WHY: Different target spellings produce separate buckets, which makes fallback ratios misleading or invisible.
- tests/test_implement_semble_contract.py:165-171 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test was weakened to accept a diagnose render path that does not pass Serena hints.
